about.title: About Bebco Environmental Controls Corporation
text: Bebco Environmental Controls Corporation is independently owned and was incorporated in 2012. However, our history of innovative product manufacturing actually extends back to 1967, upon the formation of Bebco Industries, Incorporated, which is where our CEO and key management associates began their careers.

Spanning back over 36 years ago to 1967, B.E. (Benny) Baucom, as an instrument engineer hailing from Fayetteville Tennessee, began a company called Bebco Industries in La Marque, Texas. The name was an acronym for the “B. E. Baucom Company”, and is now recognized worldwide.

By 1975, operations that began in two small buildings in La Marque, Texas doubled in size, as his son Mike oversaw construction of a new crane served building, and began gaining project and business management experience at an early age. Over the years, facility expansion continued to more than triple its original size.
